description: In the Herbrand interpretation associated with \(b\), evaluating any actual term \(s\) under a ground-term assignment \(\sigma\) gives exactly its syntactic substitution \(s[\sigma]\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.term_realize_substitution.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundAtom L))
  (t : L.Term α) (σ : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize σ t = t.subst σ
